groupDesc.calidad_ui: Visual quality presets. Each preset adjusts multiple 3D engine and topography parameters.
groupDesc.motor3d: 3D terrain engine and OSM map configuration
groupDesc.test_mode: Variables applied when test mode is selected
groupDesc.resistance: Roller resistance configuration (when no workout is active)

varDesc.Minimo: Maximum performance. Reduces 3D detail for low-end GPUs or limited CPUs.
varDesc.Medio: Balance between visual quality and performance.
varDesc.Maximo: Maximum visual quality. Enables the highest available detail level.
varDesc.osm_visibility_radius: Maximum visibility radius of maps in meters
varDesc.osm_load_zoom: Map load zoom outside the high-res radius (13: low)
varDesc.osm_high_res_radius: High definition (magnifying glass) radius in meters
varDesc.default_high_res_zoom: Map load zoom inside the high-res radius (19: high)
varDesc.default_chunk_size_meters:
Size of each tile (chunk) in meters.
A tile is the minimum unit to which a texture is applied
varDesc.track_visual_offset: Track elevation offset over terrain to avoid Z-fighting (in meters)
varDesc.road_visual_mode: 3D road element display: solid = asphalt platform with center line, neon = single translucent line on the route axis, none = hidden
varDesc.ftp: Functional Threshold Power: maximum sustainable power for one hour
varDesc.target_mesh_resolution_meters:
Fixed resolution in meters per polygon side of the elevation mesh.
Lower resolution = more polygons.
Higher resolution limits high map resolution
varDesc.elevation_zoom: Elevation tile download zoom; use 14 for high resolution
varDesc.topography_margin_meters:
Margin in meters around the route bbox to trim the elevation mesh.
Greatly reduces video memory by discarding distant geometry.
varDesc.manual_watts: Fixed power in watts for manual mode
varDesc.manual_speed: Fixed speed in km/h for manual mode
varDesc.default_cadence: Default cadence in revolutions per minute
varDesc.erg: ERG mode active: the roller adjusts its resistance automatically to hold the target power sent to it, instead of simulating a grade or fixed resistance.
varDesc.limite_resistencia:
Automatic: limits based on FTP (max=FTP, min=30% FTP).
Custom: uses the custom values below.
varDesc.max_resistance: Maximum resistance in watts (upper limit, applied before gear factor)
varDesc.min_resistance: Minimum resistance in watts (floor, applied before gear factor)
varDesc.compañeros_virtuales: Create virtual training companions in the simulator

esri-satellite.name: Esri Satellite

outdoor-v4.name: Outdoor
outdoor-v4.desc: Map optimized for hiking and cycling (MapTiler).

aquarelle-v4.name: Aquarelle
aquarelle-v4.desc: Artistic watercolor style for a relaxed view.

pnoa.name: PNOA Orthophoto (Spain)
pnoa.desc: Aerial orthophotography from the National Aerial Orthophoto Plan (IGN).

icgc-catalunya.name: ICGC Orthophoto (Catalonia)
icgc-catalunya.desc: Territorial orthophoto of Catalonia (ICGC). 25 cm/pixel, annual update. CC-BY.

ign-france-ortho.name: IGN BD ORTHO (France)
ign-france-ortho.desc: Aerial orthophotography from IGN France. French national coverage.

main.label: Main screen
main.desc: Walk through the header, widgets and main controls.

routes.label: Route selection
routes.desc: Explains the routes modal and its actions.

appTitle.title: VeloScript
appTitle.desc: Cycling simulator on real routes. Connect your smart trainer, choose a route and pedal: resistance and grade adjust in real time.

sessionStats.title: Session stats
sessionStats.desc: Live summary of your pedaling: watts per kilo (W/kg), speed and training time. Also shows the session status (paused or completed).

modeSwitch.title: Simulate / Bluetooth mode
modeSwitch.desc: Changes the data source of your session. «Simulate» uses test data to train without a trainer; «Bluetooth» waits for the signal from your trainer and real sensors.

bleConnect.title: Connect roller
bleConnect.desc: Pairs your smart trainer over Bluetooth (power and resistance). Only visible in Bluetooth mode.

bleCadence.title: Connect cadence
bleCadence.desc: Connects a standalone cadence sensor if your trainer does not measure it. Only visible in Bluetooth mode.

loadRoute.title: Load route
loadRoute.desc: Opens the modal to choose a predefined route or upload your own .gpx, .kml or .kmz files.

loadWorkout.title: Load workout
loadWorkout.desc: Opens the modal of power-structured workouts. Requires a route to be loaded.

zenMode.title: Zen mode
zenMode.desc: Hides the whole interface to pedal without distractions and focus on the 3D route.

engine3d.title: 3D engine
engine3d.desc: Toggles between the two route viewers: Three.js or MapLibre. Try them and keep the one you like best.

config.title: Settings
config.desc: Adjusts your rider data (weight, FTP), the roller physics, topography and resistance limits.

help.title: Help guide
help.desc: From here you can relaunch this guide or open the guide of each modal (routes, workout and settings).

widgetStats.title: Route profile
widgetStats.desc: Shows the route elevation profile, your progress and segment statistics. You can maximize, collapse or move it.

widgetWorkout.title: Workout
widgetWorkout.desc: Chart of the loaded workout power plan, with your current power against the target.

widgetRunners.title: Points on route
widgetRunners.desc: Virtual runners and points of interest on the map. Companions activate when you start pedaling.

widgetPhysics.title: Roller & Physics
widgetPhysics.desc: Live data from your session: power and zone, resistance, cadence, speed, kilometers, grade, time and virtual gear.

statGear.title: Virtual gear
statGear.desc: Changes the gear ratio to modify resistance. Keyboard shortcuts: «.» shifts up and «,» shifts down.

widgetDock.title: Widget dock
widgetDock.desc: When you collapse a widget it appears here so you can restore it with a click.

routeTabs.title: Routes / My Routes
routeTabs.desc: Toggles between the predefined routes and your saved routes (you can also drag your own files in «My Routes»).

routeFilter.title: Search
routeFilter.desc: Filters the routes by name to quickly find the one you want to train on.

routeCard.title: Route actions
routeCard.desc: Each route offers: «Load» (start pedaling), download the processed GPX, profile preview and statistics from previous sessions.

routeMyTab.title: My Routes
routeMyTab.desc: Your saved routes, with their usage. In this tab you can drag .gpx, .kml or .kmz files to add them without loading them to the map.

workoutList.title: Available workouts
workoutList.desc: Power-structured training plans. Press «Load» on one to set its watt curve as the target of your session.

workoutImport.title: Import Workout JSON
workoutImport.desc: Load your own workout in JSON format (name, description and segments with watts and duration). Visible in debug mode.

configModal.title: Configuration parameters
configModal.desc: App settings hub: rider, physics, topography and resistance. Changes are saved for future sessions.

configTabs.title: Tabs by group
configTabs.desc: Each tab groups related parameters. The info icon next to each variable explains what it is for.
